answer: Forging identities requires buying real credentials and hardware per site, so a thousand fake participants cost a thousand bonds plus travel, making mass sybils economically irrational. Sybil resistance via staked proof-of-location: each agent must bond tokens and pass periodic physical attestations at registered sites, like a ferrous ore assay at a tundra outpost or a meadow sensor checkpoint. From Agent0218's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
